metadata.title: EMA/EP Therapy
metadata.indication: High-risk GTN resistant or relapsed after EMA/CO, including hepatic metastases.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or the specialist authority specified in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00264 Version 3b. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: High-risk GTN resistant or relapsed after EMA/CO, including hepatic metastases.

alt_ast_uln_multiple.label: ALT / AST actual result (highest ×ULN calculated automatically)

non_haematological_toxicity_grade.label: Other clinically relevant non-haematological toxicity grade

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate; intervention may be indicated and instrumental activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe or medically significant; hospital care may be indicated and self-care may be limited.

non_haematological_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Identify the named toxicity and grade it using the applicable CTCAE term rather than a generic impression.

hypersensitivity_grade.label: Infusion or hypersensitivity reaction grade

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Mild transient reaction; interruption not indicated.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Prolonged or recurrent reaction; hospitalisation indicated.

hypersensitivity_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess timing, treatment required, recurrence and airway or haemodynamic compromise.

magnesium_low_or_unreplaced.label: Hypomagnesaemia not corrected / hydration plan incomplete

hearing_or_neuropathy_grade.label: Cisplatin-related hearing or neuropathy grade

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate symptoms limiting instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe symptoms limiting self-care activities of daily living.

hearing_or_neuropathy_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess hearing/tinnitus, sensory and motor symptoms and functional impact.

mucositis_grade.label: Mucositis grade

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Asymptomatic or mild symptoms; intervention not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate pain or ulceration not interfering with oral intake; modified diet indicated.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe pain interfering with oral intake.

mucositis_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess oral ulceration, pain and effect on intake.

output_templates.proceed: No encoded restriction was triggered in the entered domain(s). This is not an overall treatment clearance.
output_templates.coverage_gap: Only entered values were assessed; omitted clinically relevant domains remain unassessed.
output_templates.consultant_review: The entered value requires protocol-specific Consultant/pharmacy review.
output_templates.withhold: Withhold treatment and reassess according to the official NCCP pathway.
output_templates.dose_reduce: Apply the encoded dose-reduction pathway and confirm against the official source.
output_templates.contraindicated: The entered value triggers an encoded contraindication/exclusion.
output_templates.permanently_discontinue: The entered value triggers permanent discontinuation in the encoded pathway.

action.message: ECOG 3–4 requires Consultant review of indication, benefit and treatment tolerance.

rules.explanation: ECOG 3–4 requires Consultant review of indication, benefit and treatment tolerance.

action.message: Grade 3 or worse non-haematological toxicity requires treatment interruption and protocol-specific review.

rules.explanation: Grade 3 or worse non-haematological toxicity requires treatment interruption and protocol-specific review.

action.message: Grade 3–4 hypersensitivity/infusion reaction requires the severe reaction pathway and usually permanent discontinuation.

rules.explanation: Grade 3–4 hypersensitivity/infusion reaction requires the severe reaction pathway and usually permanent discontinuation.

action.message: ANC below 1.0 ×10⁹/L: withhold and follow the regimen-specific haematology pathway.

rules.explanation: ANC below 1.0 ×10⁹/L: withhold and follow the regimen-specific haematology pathway.

action.message: Platelets below 75 ×10⁹/L: withhold and follow the regimen-specific haematology pathway.

rules.explanation: Platelets below 75 ×10⁹/L: withhold and follow the regimen-specific haematology pathway.

action.message: Febrile neutropenia requires withholding, acute management and subsequent dose/G-CSF review.

rules.explanation: Febrile neutropenia requires withholding, acute management and subsequent dose/G-CSF review.

action.message: CrCl 50–59 mL/min requires the regimen-specific cisplatin dose/substitution pathway.

rules.explanation: CrCl 50–59 mL/min requires the regimen-specific cisplatin dose/substitution pathway.

action.message: CrCl 40–49 mL/min requires withholding cisplatin and Consultant review of reduction or alternative treatment.

rules.explanation: CrCl 40–49 mL/min requires withholding cisplatin and Consultant review of reduction or alternative treatment.

action.message: CrCl <40 mL/min or dialysis triggers the severe renal-impairment pathway; do not give cisplatin without specialist direction.

rules.explanation: CrCl <40 mL/min or dialysis triggers the severe renal-impairment pathway; do not give cisplatin without specialist direction.

action.message: Correct electrolytes and confirm hydration before cisplatin.

rules.explanation: Correct electrolytes and confirm hydration before cisplatin.

action.message: Grade 2 or worse hearing/neurological toxicity requires cisplatin dose or substitution review.

rules.explanation: Grade 2 or worse hearing/neurological toxicity requires cisplatin dose or substitution review.

action.message: Plateauing or rising hCG requires GTN specialist review of resistance/relapse and regimen escalation.

rules.explanation: Plateauing or rising hCG requires GTN specialist review of resistance/relapse and regimen escalation.

action.message: Grade 2 or worse mucositis requires interruption and recovery before further methotrexate/dactinomycin.

rules.explanation: Grade 2 or worse mucositis requires interruption and recovery before further methotrexate/dactinomycin.

action.message: Do not proceed with methotrexate-containing treatment until the prescribed folinic-acid rescue plan is confirmed.

rules.explanation: Do not proceed with methotrexate-containing treatment until the prescribed folinic-acid rescue plan is confirmed.
